coverage_scope.primary: Every one of the 439 records in the matching published and repository ontology.json, including provisional nodes and multiple-parent paths.
coverage_scope.secondary: Design memoranda, Ontology.md, canonical overlay, snapshot manifest, historical YAML, and vocabulary audit inspected as context. Imported alternative browsers and lexical reservoirs are not claimed as exhaustively mapped.

formalization.alternate_parent_semantics: Additional valid superclass, not role, location, provenance, or merely similar category.
formalization.facet_semantics: Defined intersection, complement relative to a base class, contextual predicate restriction, or an operational facet requiring a domain criterion.
formalization.predicate_semantics: Typed predicate records are instances of specification classes; application is a separate typed relation, not class membership of the arguments.
formalization.reification: Reify each predicate or class specification with its own identifier; relate it to a formal symbol explicitly. OWL punning alone does not imply semantic identity.
formalization.foundational_limits: No unrestricted comprehension, universal self-membership, global class-of-all-classes object, or automatic conversion of a predicate specification class into an OWL property.
